JustPark | Lead Engineers | London (Hybrid) & Dallas (Hybrid) | Full-time

JustPark is a parking platform serving millions of drivers and operators across the UK and US. We're hiring two lead engineers.

Lead Full Stack Engineer – London, UK React/TypeScript + PHP/Laravel/Go. Lead engineers across our consumer platform, contribute to architecture, and help us scale internationally. 5+ years across the full stack. We welcome applications from seniors wanting to step into a lead role. Apply: https://apply.workable.com/justpark/j/6016D774E3/

Lead Engineer, Oobeo Platform – Dallas, TX Player-coach role: Django/Python, React, React Native, AWS + GCP. You'll own the codebase and manage the team. Strong AI-paired development culture — we're daily Claude Code users and want someone who'll bring the team along. 8+ years backend experience. Apply: https://apply.workable.com/justpark/j/48D1D405D8/

If you're applying from HackerNews, please mention it in your application!
